title: Calibrate Content Response
description: Response payload with verdict and detailed explanations for collaborative calibration

oneOf.description: Success response with detailed calibration feedback

explanation.description: Detailed natural language explanation of the decision

features.description: Per-feature breakdown with explanations. Mirrors validate_content_delivery feature shape so calibration loops can correlate against production verdicts by policy_id.

feature_id.description: Which feature was evaluated. Data features come from the content-standards feature catalog (e.g., 'brand_safety', 'brand_suitability', 'competitor_adjacency'). Record-level structural checks use reserved namespaces: 'record:malformed_artifact'. Reserved prefixes: 'record:', 'delivery:'.

policy_id.description: Policy ID that triggered this result. Enables the calibration loop to iterate on specific policies by correlating sample outcomes to policy ids.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why this feature passed or failed

confidence.description: Optional evaluator confidence in this result (0-1). Distinguishes certain verdicts from ambiguous ones.

oneOf.description: Error response. A body that is also a valid success response is the success shape, even when it lists `errors`.

examples.explanation: This content aligns well with the brand's fitness-focused positioning. Health and fitness content is explicitly marked as 'ideal' in the policy. The discussion is constructive and educational.

features.explanation: No safety concerns. Content is user-generated but constructive fitness discussion.
Fitness content matches brand's athletic positioning.

examples.explanation: This content discusses political topics which the policy explicitly excludes. While the article itself is balanced journalism, the brand has requested to avoid all controversial political content regardless of tone.

features.explanation: No hate speech, illegal content, or explicit material.
Political content is excluded by brand policy, even when balanced.
